```{r}
#| label: load-libraries
#| output: false
rm(list=ls())
set.seed(2514)
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
```

## Prepare Data

### Load Research Data (ENIGMA)

```{r}
#| label: load-enigma-data
#| output: false
# Load ENIGMA centiles
enigma_df <- read_csv('../data/ENIGMA/ENIGMA_data.csv',
                      show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
                  mutate(euler_mpr = euler)
```

### Load Clinical Data

```{r}
#| label: load-chop-data
#| output: false
# modality controls which CHOP centile file is loaded and the suffix used for the
# saved output below: "combined" (main analyses) merges the full CHOP centile set
# with CT/mean-CT columns computed separately from MPRAGE-only ("mpr") scans, since
# reliable CT requires the MPR sequence and is only available for a subset of scans
# (age >= 2 years, hence the age_days filter below)
modality <- "mpr"

if (modality == "mpr") {
  suf <- "_mpr"
} else if (modality == "all") {
  suf <- "_all"
} else if (modality == "combined") {
  suf <- "_combined"
}
if (modality != "combined") {
  # Load centile data
  chop_df <- read_csv(glue('../data/CHOP/CHOP_data{suf}.csv'), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
                    mutate(euler_mpr = euler)

} else {
  # Load all centile data
  chop_df <- read_csv(glue('../data/CHOP/CHOP_data_all.csv'), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
                    select(-starts_with("CT."),-starts_with("meanCT")) %>%
                    select(-c(ss_qc))
  print(dim(chop_df))
  # Load MPR centile data
  chop_mpr_df <- read_csv(glue('../data/CHOP/CHOP_data_mpr.csv'), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
                    select(-starts_with("GM."),-starts_with("SA."),
                           -starts_with("SUBC."),-starts_with("SS."),
                           -starts_with("totalSA"),-starts_with("GMV"),
                           -starts_with("WMV"), -starts_with("eTIV"),
                           -starts_with("sGMV"),-starts_with("Cerebellum"),
                           -starts_with("Ventricles")) %>%
                    mutate(euler_mpr = euler, .after = euler) %>%
                    filter(age_days >= (365.25*2+280)) %>%
                    select(participant, sex, age_days, dx, euler_mpr,
                           starts_with("CT."),starts_with("meanCT"))

  chop_df <- full_join(chop_df, chop_mpr_df) %>%
                filter(!is.na(Source))
}

# Rescale CHOP volumes to match ENIGMA data
chop_df <- chop_df %>% mutate(across(contains("Transformed.normalised"), ~ .x/10000))
```

### Identify Cohort-Specific Features to Drop

```{r}
#| label: check-column-overlap
#| echo: false
#| output: false
# Identify centile feature columns present in only one cohort (e.g. due to
# differing segmentation atlases) so they can be dropped before combining below
print("ENIGMA Columns Missing")
missing_enigma <- colnames(enigma_df)[!(colnames(enigma_df) %in% colnames(chop_df)) &
                                      endsWith(colnames(enigma_df),"q.wre")]

print("CHOP Columns Missing")
missing_CHOP <- colnames(chop_df)[!(colnames(chop_df) %in% colnames(enigma_df)) &
                                      endsWith(colnames(chop_df),"q.wre") &
                                      !startsWith(colnames(chop_df),"SS.")]

exclude_cols <- c(missing_enigma, missing_CHOP)
```

### Combine Data

```{r}
#| label: combine-chop-enigma

# Bind ENIGMA and CHOP data into a single dataset
df <- bind_rows(chop_df,enigma_df) %>%
          dplyr::select(-all_of(exclude_cols), -dx_psychosis)
table(df$Source, df$dx)
```

```{r}
#| label: recode-variables
#| output: false
df$Source <- factor(df$Source,levels = c("ENIGMA","CHOP"))
df$dx <- factor(df$dx,levels = c("CN","22q11DS"))
df$age_years <- (df$age_days - 280)/365.25

# Recode site optionally to include CHOP as single site when matching with ENIGMA
df$site2 <- df$site
df$site2[df$Source == "CHOP"] <- "CHOP"
```

### Z-Score Data

```{r}
#| label: compute-centile-zscores
#| output: false
# Convert centiles to z-scores; centiles of exactly 0/1 are nudged to just inside
# (0, 1) since qnorm(0) / qnorm(1) are undefined (+/-Inf)
zscores <- df %>%
              select(contains("Transformed.q.wre")) %>%
              mutate(across(everything(), .fns = ~ ifelse(. == 1, 0.9999999999999999, .)),
                     across(everything(), .fns = ~ ifelse(. == 0, 0.0000000000000001, .)),
                     across(everything(), qnorm))
colnames(zscores) <- str_replace_all(colnames(zscores), "Transformed.q.wre","Transformed.q.zscore")

#Bind z-score to original results
df <- bind_cols(df, zscores)
```

```{r}
#| label: filter-deletion-type-and-sites
# Exclude atypical deletions (non-A-D)
df <- df %>% 
        mutate(Deletion_Type = case_when(is.na(Deletion_Type) & dx == "22q11DS" ~ "FISH",
                                          dx == "CN" ~ "None",
                                          .default = Deletion_Type)) %>% 
        filter((Deletion_Type %in% c("A-D","None")))

# Remove ENIGMA sites that don't have cases
enigma_sites <- df %>%
                  filter(Source == "ENIGMA") %>%
                  group_by(dx, site) %>%
                  summarize(n = n()) %>%
                  pivot_wider(id_cols = "site", names_from = "dx", values_from = "n") %>%
                  filter(!is.na(`22q11DS`))

df <- df %>% filter(site2 %in% c("CHOP", enigma_sites$site))

table(df$Deletion_Type, df$Source, useNA = "ifany")
```

### Specify Features to Test

```{r}
#| label: define-analysis-features
#| output: false
features <- colnames(df)[endsWith(colnames(df),".q.wre") &
                           !startsWith(colnames(df),"SS.")] %>%
              str_replace_all("Transformed.q.wre","")

# Exclude cerebellar and ventricular regions, we'll treat them as global only
exclude_list <- c("SUBC.x4th_Ventricle","SUBC.x3rd_Ventricle",
                  "SUBC.Left_Cerebellum_Cortex","SUBC.Right_Cerebellum_Cortex",
                  "SUBC.Left_Inf_Lat_Vent","SUBC.Right_Inf_Lat_Vent","SUBC.Brain.Stem",
                  "SUBC.Left_Lateral_Ventricle","SUBC.Right_Lateral_Ventricle")

features <- features[!(features %in% exclude_list)]

features.ct    <- glue('{features[startsWith(features,"CT.")]}Transformed.q.wre')
features.sa   <- glue('{features[startsWith(features,"SA.")]}Transformed.q.wre')
features.gm    <- glue('{features[startsWith(features,"GM.")]}Transformed.q.wre')
features.subc    <- glue('{features[startsWith(features,"SUBC.")]}Transformed.q.wre')
```

### Identify Longitudinal Samples

```{r}
#| label: identify-overlapping-and-longitudinal-samples
#| output: false
# Find CHOP Samples with multiple visits
multi_samples <- df$participant %in% names(which(table(df$participant) > 1))

df$participant[!is.na(df$SubjID)] <- df$SubjID[!is.na(df$SubjID)]

# Make a df of only longitudinal samples for later
df.long <- df[multi_samples,]

```

```{r}
#| label: select-one-sample-per-participant
# Select one sample per individual, prioritizing
  # (a) normal pathology
  # (b) presence of CT measure
  # (c) young age
df <- df %>% arrange(desc(pathology == "Normal"), is.na(meanCTTransformed.q.wre), age_days)
df <- df[!(df %>% select(participant, Source) %>% duplicated()),]
df$main_analysis <- TRUE

table(df$Source, df$dx)
```

### Get dataframe of abnormal morphology

```{r}
#| label: separate-abnormal-pathology
abnormal_pathology <- df %>% filter(pathology == "Abnormal" & !is.na(pathology))
df <- df %>% filter(pathology == "Normal" | is.na(pathology))
table(df$dx, df$Source, useNA = "ifany")
```

### Remove SLIP controls that no longer match

```{r}
#| label: filter-unmatched-controls
# `matched` flags controls that were paired to cases via demographic matching
# upstream; controls left unmatched after case-level exclusions above are dropped
# here to preserve the intended case:control matching
df_all <- df
df <- df %>%
        mutate(matched = ifelse(is.na(matched), TRUE, matched)) %>%
        filter(matched)
table(df$dx,df$Source)
```

## Prepare MRI Atlases

### Set Up Atlases

```{r}
#| label: load-atlas-libraries
#| output: false
library(ggseg)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggsegTissue)
```

```{r}
#| label: prepare-brain-atlas-labels
#| output: false
# Some labels in each atlas are NA, replace with the ROI
dk_plot <- as_tibble(ggseg::dk)
dk_plot$label[is.na(dk_plot$label)] <- dk_plot$roi[is.na(dk_plot$label)]

aseg_plot <- as_tibble(ggseg::aseg) %>%
                mutate(label = str_replace_all(label, "-","_"))
aseg_plot$roi <- sprintf("%04d", as.numeric(rownames(aseg_plot)))
aseg_plot$label[is.na(aseg_plot$label)] <- aseg_plot$roi[is.na(aseg_plot$label)]
```

### Set up color scheme

```{r}
#| label: define-color-scheme
#| output: false
color_scheme <- c("royalblue","white","firebrick")
```

## Save Environment

```{r}
#| label: save-analysis-dataset
#| output: false
# Save objects used in downstream analysis scripts 
#
#   df                  analysis-ready CHOP + ENIGMA centile/deviation data
#   df_all              full CHOP 22q11DS sample before per-participant selection
#   df.long             longitudinal (multi-session) subset
#   abnormal_pathology  scans excluded for pathology, used in sensitivity analyses
#   features            feature names modeled throughout
#   dk_plot / aseg_plot ggseg atlases used by the plotting helpers in utils.R
#   color_scheme        shared brain-map colour scale
#
# Output is analysis_prep_combined.RData or analysis_prep_mpr.RData depending on
# `modality` above (combined = main analyses; mpr = MPR-only sensitivity analyses)
save(list = c("df", "df_all", "df.long", "abnormal_pathology",
              "features",
              "dk_plot", "aseg_plot", "color_scheme"),
     file = glue('../data/analysis_prep{suf}.RData'))
```
